ecoSynthesis (0.0.0.9000)

The goal of ecoSynthesis is to …

This package is a work in progress and is not yet ready for use. Please check back later for updates.

Please find more information about the Environmental Indicators Initiative here; https://ardc.edu.au/project/environmental-indicators-initiative/, and the Ecosystem Indicator Workflows project here; https://ardc.edu.au/project/ecosystem-indicator-workflows/.

Installation

You can install the development version of ecoSynthesis from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Ecosystem-Indicators-Workflows/ecoSynthesis")

Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

library(ecoSynthesis)

input_table <- data.frame(
  re1 = c(
    "Semi-deciduous Forest",
    "Deciduous Forest",
    "Wet Montane Forest",
    "Dry Montane Forest"
  ),
  efg1 = c("T1.1", "T1.2", "T1.1", "T1.2"),
  memb1 = c(80, 80, 70, 50),
  efg2 = c("T1.2", "T1.1", "T1.3", "T1.3"),
  memb2 = c(20, 20, 30, 50)
)

membership_table(
  input_table,
  "re1",
  c("efg1", "efg2", "efg3"),
  c("memb1", "memb2"),
  target = "T1.3"
)
